ContactId.title: ContactId
ContactId.description: Salesforce ID of the Contact to retrieve. Use when the ID is known. If not known, provide LastName instead.

LastName.title: LastName
LastName.description: Last name of the Contact to retrieve. Use when the ID is not known. Provide AccountName as well if there may be multiple contacts with the same last name.

AccountName.title: AccountName
AccountName.description: Name of the Account the Contact belongs to. Used to disambiguate when multiple contacts share the same last name.
